A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 12-page versions of the same DSB paper. Text and visual comparison covers all equations, Tables 1–2, Figures 1–8, and Appendices A–B without material gaps.

before.justification: v1 reports original accuracy and throughput experiments across four models and five benchmarks, plus ablations in Section 5.3 and Appendix A.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark experiments, cache ablations, parameter analyses, and Appendix A suffix-window results.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 and Sections 4.1–4.2 retain identical DSB boundary updates, constant and greedy variants, and DSB Cache procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate GSM8K, MATH, HumanEval, MBPP, and BBH with the same task coverage. No training or evaluation scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain the same comparison configurations involving vanilla Top-1 sampling, Fast-dLLM confidence-aware decoding, naive block scheduling, and Dual Cache. Comparator membership also remains unchanged in the plotted analyses.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 retains the same models, few-shot settings, accuracy and TPS metrics, generation length of 256, initial block length of 32, and confidence threshold of 0.9. The ablation protocols also match.

E4.justification: The prefix-window ablation in Table 2, parameter analyses in Figures 4–7, and suffix-window analysis in Appendix A and Figure 8 are identical.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All result entries and plotted trends in Tables 1–2 and Figures 4–8 match. For example, both report 80.29 accuracy and 99.61 TPS for cached DSB (greedy) on GSM8K with LLaDA-8B-Instruct.

T1.justification: Sections 3–4 retain identical mathematical definitions, sampling equations, block-boundary updates, and prefix-window formulas. No assumption, derivation, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same training-free DSB and DSB Cache contributions and claims about improving generation quality and inference efficiency.

C2.justification: The explanations of boundary-cache instability, model-dependent performance, and parameter tradeoffs are unchanged. Appendix A retains the same conclusion that suffix windows provide inconsistent benefits, and Appendix B is identical.

D1.justification: The NVIDIA H200 hardware, lm-eval implementation, hyperparameters, and code-release link are identical. Neither version adds implementation or access information.

R1.justification: Section 2, citations, and references are unchanged, including positioning relative to WeDLM, AdaBlock-dLLM, Fast-dLLM, and dKV-Cache.

P1.justification: v2 replaces the erroneous running header 'Submission and Formatting Instructions for ICML 2026' on pages 2–12 with the paper title. It also updates the preprint date and arXiv version/date marking. All body prose and section organization remain identical.

P2.justification: All figures, tables, captions, equations, and their placement are visually identical. The header and date wording edits do not alter the page layout.

improvement.justification: v2 corrects a template running header and updates date/version markings, providing cosmetic cleanup. The scientific exposition, results, reproducibility information, and appendices are identical, so the revision produces no meaningful overall quality change.
